title.zh: U4 attempt4 双签包：重采开窗前基线（三点 free 13079 / floor 10007 MiB）入证
title.en: U4 attempt4 double-sign package: re-measured pre-window baseline (free 13079 / floor 10007 MiB) recorded

intent.zh: 按双签前置要求在开窗前重采三点 GPU 基线（只读 nvidia-smi）：free 13079/13079/13079 MiB、used 2983 MiB、util 28/33/30%、driver 596.36；floor = min(free) − 3072 = 10007 MiB；写入 material v3 的 baseline-pre-window-v3.txt，更新 receipt 的 baseline 块与 manifest，供 Chief 报用户双签。零 GPU 负载、零冻结。
intent.en: Re-measure the three-point pre-window GPU baseline before signing (read-only nvidia-smi): free 13079/13079/13079 MiB, used 2983 MiB, util 28/33/30 %, driver 596.36; floor = min(free) - 3072 = 10007 MiB; record it in material v3 baseline-pre-window-v3.txt and update the receipt baseline block + manifest for Chief to take to the user.

acceptance: baseline-pre-window-v3.txt：三点原始 nvidia-smi（free/used/util/timestamp）、driver/总显存、min(free)=13079、floor=10007 MiB、窗口时复测低于 floor 即停；声明取代 2026-10-31 的 8400/5328 旧基线。
receipt 的 baseline 块与本文件一致（含 floor 10007 与 window_rule）；manifest 覆盖 baseline 文件与更新后的 receipt；四门禁 + --no-run 通过；零 GPU 负载、零冻结、未改判据/参考/内核。
note: Arch 2026-11-01 注册（step-3 第 6 片 = 双签包）：只有只读 nvidia-smi 采样与证据写入；窗口仍不开、不冻结。之后计划 + 基线报 Chief。
